summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built and evaluated deep learning models for medical imaging, including a multi-modal MRI segmentation pipeline on BraTS 2020 using U-Net with VGG and ResNet-50 backbones scored on Dice and IoU, and fine-tuned transformer models on clinical document data in PyTorch and Hugging Face, raising field-extraction accuracy from 55% to 93%. Experienced in taking research prototypes to production deployment via ONNX and TFLite export and 8-bit quantization.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU, reporting accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized decoder embedding layer accordingly.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on a custom 1,133-image annotated detection dataset achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization; used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase — near-lossless compression.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch (multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm) with a custom training loop and perplexity evaluation.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
